description: This file defines the UniqueKey class, which represents a unique identifier used within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for creating, parsing, comparing, and serializing unique keys, as well as handling different categories and key extensions.

classes.name: UniqueKey
classes.description: A sealed class representing a unique identifier within the Orleans runtime, supporting comparison, serialization, and various key creation methods.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string or span into a UniqueKey instance, supporting hex and GUID formats.

methods.name: NewKey
methods.description: Creates a new UniqueKey instance with specified parameters, including GUID, category, and type data.

methods.name: NewSystemTargetKey
methods.description: Creates a new system target key with specified GUID or system ID.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Extracts the category from the type code data.
